newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp falls on reports of possible lower earnings.
newsitem.headline: Sharp falls on reports of possible lower earnings.

text.p: Sharp Corp shares were lower on Friday morning, depressed by media reports that the firm's results for the year ending March 31 may not live up to earlier forcasts, brokers said.
As of 0123 GMT, Sharp's shares were down 90 yen at 1,500, the largest percentage loser in the first section of the Tokyo bourse. Volume was 1.611 million shares.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Friday that it expected Sharp's parent current profit may fall about 2.0 billion yen short of the company's previous forecast of 74 billion yen, resulting in a rise of only two percent.
